resources.string: The app couldn\'t get Blizzard\'s downloader. Check your connection and Try again, or use Import an existing installation.
Blizzard\'s download got no data for a minute. Check your connection and Try again; what is downloaded is kept. Or use Import an existing installation.
Blizzard\'s downloader showed an error. Try again, or use Import an existing installation. If it happens again, send the logs.
Blizzard\'s downloader stopped before the download was complete. Try again, or use Import an existing installation. If it happens again, send the logs.
The game files from Blizzard\'s downloader didn\'t pass the check. Try again, or use Import an existing installation. If it happens again, send the logs.
Blizzard\'s download finished, but its files couldn\'t be saved. Check the free space and Try again.
Something the install needs has to be downloaded again. Check your connection and Try again.
Blizzard\'s downloader stopped unexpectedly. Try again, or use Import an existing installation. If it happens again, send the logs.

The Project Diablo 2 in the game folder cannot be kept as it is. Check your connection and Try again: the app needs Project Diablo 2\'s file list to record your files. If it happens again, Game.exe, ProjectDiablo.dll or another of its files is missing: import a complete folder.
A download didn\'t finish. Check your connection and Try again. What is already downloaded is kept.
Diablo II\'s installer didn\'t accept the Diablo II key. Check the key and Try again.
Lord of Destruction\'s installer didn\'t accept the Lord of Destruction key. Check the key and Try again.
Blizzard\'s installer stopped with an error. Check both CD keys and Try again.
The install didn\'t finish. Try again. What is already downloaded is kept.
